cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.
